description: Find free meeting slots shared by the logged-in viewer and selected participants on one day. Read-only: does not book or request a meeting. Use my_availability for your own free time only.

day.description: Day to search, as a days[].date value from my_availability; omit for the default day.

duration.description: B2match MeetingDuration enum value (e.g. THIRTHY, B2match's spelling); omit for the event default.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

is_long_term_networking.description: true searches the event's long-term networking calendar instead of the main meeting days.

participant_ids.description: 1-10 participant ids (from list_participants) to meet with.

name: find_meeting_slots
title: Find B2match meeting slots
